goal: Run the Vityo full regression exactly once and record independent evidence for REQ-IDE-001 through REQ-IDE-008.
description: Scope: final platform-independent validation and evidence recording only; this Node never implements or repairs product code. Preconditions: protocol-only Agent convergence Node 014e7fb0-3f51-4033-be71-eca130a4a2ea and harness-readiness Node 63016713-c527-4428-a87d-2613f8c43ac9 are completed; every other implementation prerequisite is completed; the candidate is committed and source-bearing paths are clean; plan-only and preflight pass; no receipt already covers the same commit/fingerprint; and the current user explicitly authorizes the full run. Target: execute the fixed eight-suite IDE graph for one immutable candidate, write artifacts/validation/vityo-full.json with one canonical outcome per REQ-IDE-001 through REQ-IDE-008 plus commit/platform/source/protocol/fixture digests, then complete the lifecycle only after read-only audit. Execution Method: use next-action; freeze final acceptance; invoke regression-requested once through manifest_tool; never launch the full command manually or in parallel; inspect the receipt; run Better Plan validation and label checking; dispatch the single auditor only after a passing receipt. Failure Routing: preserve a failed receipt, never rerun the unchanged commit/fingerprint, map failed requirement seams to one bounded implementation repair, use focused tests there, and re-freeze this Node before one run of a changed candidate. Design Considerations: no native package evidence, no Coding Agent full rerun, no target lowering, no skipped blocker reported as pass, and no source mutation during validation. Design Value: a simple executor follows one deterministic path and cannot certify known ownership or harness gaps. Constraints & Risks: missing tools/fixtures/compatible Agent are blocked or failed; native host/signing availability is outside this platform-independent gate; raw logs, secrets, personal paths, and machine identity never enter the receipt.

acceptance_criteria.text: Before regression-requested, all implementation prerequisites are completed, the candidate is committed and clean, plan-only and preflight pass without suite execution, explicit final-run authority exists, and no receipt already covers the same commit/source fingerprint.

The single formal ide/full invocation writes artifacts/validation/vityo-full.json with overall passed status and exactly one passed outcome for every REQ-IDE-001 through REQ-IDE-008, including standalone IDE use, Agent Workbench collaboration, protocol, MCP/security, recovery, performance, and packaging contracts.

The receipt binds commit, supported host class, stable source fingerprint, protocol-schema digest, and acceptance-fixture digest; start/end sources do not drift; no native package artifact or Coding Agent full-suite result is consumed.

After evidence is recorded, Better Plan workspace validation and requirement-label checking pass, no Vityo implementation Node remains incomplete, and the read-only audit confirms scope without rerunning the full suite.
